findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 298 requests to 76 third-party domains (median of 2 passes).
Of 10.9 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 3.9 MB (36%) came from third-party domains, 1.2 MB of it from services classified as tracking (207 requests).

43 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: 1rx.io (RhythmOne (Magnite), advertising), 2mdn.net (Google, advertising), 33across.com (33Across, advertising), 360yield.com (Improve Digital, advertising), 3lift.com (TripleLift, advertising), a-mo.net (AdaptMX, advertising), acuityplatform.com (Acuity Ads, advertising), adform.net (Adform, advertising), adnxs.com (Microsoft (Xandr), advertising), ads.linkedin.com (LinkedIn, advertising).
181 cookies were set by third-party domains (213 cookies in total).
The main document response did not include a Content-Security-Policy header or meta tag.

With the EasyPrivacy filter list applied (domain rules only, 47222 rules), 79 requests were blocked. The page still made 298 requests to 76 third-party domains, including 43 tracking services in our list.
